title: PhysicalModelFileHeader
description: The header every file in data/models/physical/ carries. These files are OUR RECONSTRUCTIONS, never canon: none of them may appear in provenance.supports of a canon claim (ADR 0005 §7). The header exists so that a reader can tell, without leaving the file, what in it was measured and what was assumed. Spec: docs/spec/physical-simulation-v1.md §5.1, acceptance criterion 10. Three rules are enforced by src/embodiment/modelfile.py rather than here, because they are about the body of the file and not its shape: (1) every numeric parameter is covered by a `source` marking; (2) a marking is one of [MEASURED] [TRANSCRIBED] [EQUATED] [DERIVED] [INT], and [INT] means assumption; (3) no file may order two characters (invariant 8).

not_canon.description: Always true. A model file that could be read as canon is the failure this field exists to make impossible.

model_version.description: Semver. It enters run_metadata: a snapshot sampled under one version does not mean the same thing under another (spec §10.4).

status.description: PROVISIONAL while any blocking sourcing gap is open. Runs using a provisional file say so in their metadata.

calibrated_against.description: What real-world instrument or literature the numbers answer to. 'model memory' is not an answer.

sourcing_gaps.description: Open entries of data/models/physical/SOURCING.md that keep this file provisional. Empty only when status is CALIBRATED.

open_questions.description: Canon open questions that fix what this file must assume while unanswered.

evidence_sufficiency.description: The file's OWN sufficiency, not a character's. physical-model.md §5.6: while the factor loadings are a declared assumption, the prior file must say so itself, and not only the character sheets.

overall.description: 1 - sd(posterior)/sd(prior) in spirit: 0 means 'this is assumption with a version number'.
